title: Scalar coherence of the reconstructed integral traces
statement: Fix the global finite-field datum of [def-pur-conventions], a prime $\ell\ne p$, finite extensions $\mathbf Q_\ell=E_0\subset E\subset F$ with valuation rings $\mathcal O_{E_0}\subset\mathcal O_E\subset\mathcal O_F$, and a smooth separated morphism $f:X\to Y$ of pure relative dimension $d\ge0$ between separated finite-type $k$-schemes. Let $P_E=Rf_{!,E}$ and $P_F=Rf_{!,F}$ be the integral compact-support functors, let $T_E=\mathbf1_{E,X}(d)[2d]$ and $T_F=\mathbf1_{F,X}(d)[2d]$, and let $C_{F/E,W}(-)=(-)\otimes^L_{\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W}}\widehat{\mathcal O}_{F,W}$ be derived coefficient extension. Choose a base trace $t_0:P_{E_0}T_0\to\mathbf1_{E_0,Y}$ with $T_0=\mathbf1_{E_0,X}(d)[2d]$. For each $L\in\{E,F\}$ let $\theta_L:C_{L/E_0,X}T_0\xrightarrow{\sim}T_L$ be the canonical twist and scalar-extension comparison and define, explicitly, $$t_L=C_{L/E_0,Y}(t_0)\circ c_{L/E_0,T_0}^{-1}\circ P_L(\theta_L^{-1}):P_LT_L\longrightarrow\mathbf1_{L,Y},$$ where $c_{L/E_0,T_0}:C_{L/E_0,Y}P_{E_0}T_0\xrightarrow{\sim}P_LC_{L/E_0,X}T_0$ is the canonical compact-support coefficient comparison. Let $a_{F/E,\mathbf1_E}:C_{F/E,X}T_E\xrightarrow{\sim}T_F$ and $c_{F/E,T_E}:C_{F/E,Y}P_ET_E\xrightarrow{\sim}P_FC_{F/E,X}T_E$ be the canonical comparisons induced by the same derived tensor and compact-support constructions. Then, with the canonical coefficient-unit and tensor-associator identifications, $$t_F\circ P_F(a_{F/E,\mathbf1_E})\circ c_{F/E,T_E}=C_{F/E,Y}(t_E).$$ The coefficient extension, compact-support functors and comparisons are those of [def-pur-conventions], [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension], [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support] and [lem-pur-compact-support-integral-coefficient-comparison].

proof.text: Write $A_W=C_{E/E_0,W}$, $B_W=C_{F/E,W}$, $D_W=C_{F/E_0,W}$ and $U_{L,W}=\mathbf1_{L,W}$. Apply [lem-pur-shifted-tate-unit-scalar-coherence] at $S=X,Y$. It supplies the finite-Tor domains of the twisted units and $A_XT_0$, and the normalized equations $\theta_F\alpha^X_{T_0}=aB_X(\theta_E)$ and $u_F\alpha^Y_{U_{0,Y}}=vB_Y(u_E)$. Here $a=a_{F/E,\mathbf1_E}$, while $u_E:A_YU_{0,Y}\to U_{E,Y}$, $u_F:D_YU_{0,Y}\to U_{F,Y}$ and $v:B_YU_{E,Y}\to U_{F,Y}$ are unit multiplication. Thus $\theta_F^{-1}a=\alpha^X_{T_0}B_X(\theta_E^{-1})$.

source.place: Coefficient-extension transport; sk-thm-purity-transport Step 3. Agent auxiliary extracted from the scalar-trace coherence calculation.

proof.text:
Apply [lem-pur-compact-support-arrow-scalar-transport] with $M=T_0$, $V=U_{0,Y}$ and $t=t_0$. Its domain hypotheses hold by Step 1; $f$ is separated finite type and $\ell\ne p$. Put $c_A=c_{E/E_0,T_0}$, $c_D=c_{F/E_0,T_0}$, $c_{B,N}=c_{F/E,N}$ and $r_E=A_Y(t_0)c_A^{-1}$, $r_F=D_Y(t_0)c_D^{-1}$. The result is
$$r_FP_F(\alpha^X_{T_0})c_{B,A_XT_0}=\alpha^Y_{U_{0,Y}}B_Y(r_E).$$
Naturality of [lem-pur-compact-support-integral-coefficient-comparison] at $\theta_E^{-1}:T_E\to A_XT_0$ gives
$$P_F(B_X\theta_E^{-1})c_{B,T_E}=c_{B,A_XT_0}B_Y(P_E\theta_E^{-1}).$$

source.place: Coefficient-extension transport; sk-thm-purity-transport Step 3. Agent auxiliary extracted from the scalar-trace coherence calculation.

proof.text:
Restore the unit maps in the explicit traces: $t_E=u_Er_EP_E(\theta_E^{-1})$ and $t_F=u_Fr_FP_F(\theta_F^{-1})$. Substitute the inverse twist equation of Step 1, the naturality equation of Step 2 and then its arrow-transport equation, using functoriality:
$$\begin{aligned}
t_FP_F(a)c_{B,T_E}
&=u_Fr_FP_F(\alpha^X_{T_0})P_F(B_X\theta_E^{-1})c_{B,T_E}\\
&=u_Fr_FP_F(\alpha^X_{T_0})c_{B,A_XT_0}B_Y(P_E\theta_E^{-1})\\
&=u_F\alpha^Y_{U_{0,Y}}B_Y(r_EP_E\theta_E^{-1})\\
&=vB_Y(u_Er_EP_E\theta_E^{-1})=vB_Y(t_E).
\end{aligned}$$
The penultimate equality is the unit equation of Step 1. Every line has source $B_YP_ET_E$ and target $U_{F,Y}$. Suppressing $v$ is exactly the coefficient-unit identification in the statement. The calculation works for every $t_0$, including zero.
